parameters.content:
## 1️⃣ Entry
Telegram → (voice? Whisper) → Decide → Route
`Decide` is the brain: it reads button taps / text and keeps each run's state.

## 🎬 GATE 1 — Angle
Gemini pitches 3 angles. You tap one or type your own.

## 🔎 Research → Script → Fact-check → 🖼️ GATE 2 (storyboard)
Web-grounded research, 10-scene script with 2 hooks, fact-check pass, 10 free AI frames as a contact sheet.

## 🎙️ GATE 3 — Voice + Render + Preview
ElevenLabs voice per scene → ffmpeg edit (Ken Burns, word-by-word captions, ducked music) → video back to Telegram.

## 🚨 Error alerts
In workflow Settings → 'Error workflow' choose THIS workflow.
